targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM completed_sessions WHERE completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Contestadas" FROM completed_sessions WHERE final_state = 1 AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(talk_time_ms) / 1000.0, 0) AS "Promedio" FROM completed_sessions WHERE talk_time_ms > 0 AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(sla_met_count) / NULLIF(SUM(calls_offered), 0), 1) AS "SLA" FROM interval_snapshots WHERE interval_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', completed_at) AS "time", queue_name AS "Cola", COUNT(*) AS "Llamadas" FROM completed_sessions WHERE completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE final_state WHEN 1 THEN 'Contestada' WHEN 2 THEN 'Sin respuesta' WHEN 3 THEN 'Ocupado' WHEN 5 THEN 'Abandonada' ELSE 'Otro' END AS "Estado", COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM completed_sessions WHERE completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY final_state ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT queue_name AS "Cola", SUM(calls_offered) AS "Ofrecidas", SUM(calls_answered) AS "Contestadas", SUM(calls_abandoned) AS "Abandonadas", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(sla_met_count) / NULLIF(SUM(calls_offered), 0), 1) AS "SLA %", ROUND(SUM(total_wait_ms)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(calls_offered), 0) / 1000, 1) AS "Espera Prom (s)" FROM interval_snapshots WHERE interval_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY queue_name ORDER BY queue_name

SELECT to_char(completed_at, 'HH24:MI') AS "Hora", caller_id_num AS "Origen", COALESCE(queue_name, '-') AS "Cola", COALESCE(agent_id, '-') AS "Agente", ROUND(talk_time_ms / 1000.0, 0) AS "Duracion (s)", CASE final_state WHEN 1 THEN 'Contestada' WHEN 5 THEN 'Abandonada' WHEN 3 THEN 'Ocupado' ELSE 'Sin rta' END AS "Estado" FROM completed_sessions ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 20
